question: What qualities characterize the twelve-syllabled great mantra hūṃ kṣe hrīṃ phaṭ?
premises: The mantra is given as hū/ kṣe hrīṃ phaṭ.
It is a great vidyā of twelve syllables.
inference: The twelve-syllabled great mantra hūṃ kṣe hrīṃ phaṭ is characterized as bestowing all things.
uncertainties: syllable count and segmentation follow traditional identification; surface kept exact
plain_english: The great mantra hū/ kṣe hrīṃ phaṭ is twelve-syllabled and bestows all things.
